# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref-comm-combined

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`coop --git` (two agents with messaging and a shared git remote) with the frozen reference settings (`gemini-3.8-flash` on Vertex AI, `medium` thinking, 500 steps, compaction at 128K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap, `-c 4` concurrency) on the 50-pair `flash` subset, enabling both `delivery_timing: true` and `message_intents: true` (`intent_presubmit_check: true`) (`configs/variants/comm_combined_medium.yaml`). Compares directly against the two `coop --git` `medium` reference baseline runs ([`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex/summary.md) at 35/50 and [`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref/summary.md) at 33/50).

## Observations

- **33/50 (66%) passed (33/50 clean-merge passes, 1 merge conflict, 0 step-limit cutoffs, 0 agent errors)** at `$97.66` (`271` min, `39` rate-limit retries), matching the [`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref/summary.md) repeat baseline (`33/50` passed; `+1` win on `pallets_click_task/2068` (6,7), `-1` loss on `dspy_task/8394` (3,4)) and within 1–2 pairs of the `34.0/50` (`68.0%`) mean of the two `medium` reference baseline runs (`35/50` and `33/50`).
- **49/50 pairs merged cleanly (45 clean, 4 identical branches)** with a single merge conflict (`dspy_task/8394` (3,4)), `1,334` total messages sent (median `25`/pair, down from `1,353–1,439` in the two baseline runs), `8,302` total steps (median `82`/agent), and `104` compactions (compared to `87–153` in the two baseline runs).
- **Combining `delivery_timing` + `message_intents` finishes 14–28% faster in wall time** (`271` min vs. `317` min and `375` min on the two baseline runs at `-c 4`) while achieving the same clean-merge pass rate (`33/50`) as `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref`.
